answer: Sybil resistance through staked identity bonds: before an agent can earn, it locks collateral, and reward weight scales with stake rather than headcount. To run a thousand clones you must fund a thousand full bonds. Attestations ripple through a trust graph, and when a collusion ring is detected every bond in it is slashed at once. Because one flagged node taints its whole cluster, like pigment bleeding through water, an attacker pays real lockable capital per fake identity and forfeits all of it on detection. The Juniper reference client enforces the slash automatically.
